summary.name: Deep Learning with Python
summary.one_liner: A Manning book by Keras creator François Chollet that introduces deep learning from first principles using Python and the Keras library.
use_cases: learning deep learning from first principles
applying deep learning to text and sequences
experimenting with neural style transfer and generative models
summary.what_it_does: The book introduces the field of deep learning using Python and the Keras library, written by Keras creator and Google AI researcher François Chollet. It covers deep learning from first principles and how to set up a deep-learning environment. It includes practical examples in image classification, deep learning for text and sequences, and neural style transfer, text generation, and image generation. The page includes reader quotes describing it as clear and hands-on, but these are marketing testimonials.
notable: Written by Keras creator François Chollet
Covers computer vision, NLP, and generative models with Keras
Sold through Manning's subscription plans that include the ebook
caveats: Book price listed as $49.99 monthly or $499.99 annually for the Manning subscription, which includes this ebook; the book alone is not priced on the page
Platform and format details beyond the Manning subscription are not stated
